usage: 爺爺 (je4 je4) is a noun used to refer to a grandfather on the father's side in Cantonese.
It is common to use 爺爺 in family conversations when talking about paternal grandparents.
You can use 爺爺 as the subject or object in a sentence, e.g., ‘我個爺爺好好’ (My grandfather is nice).
爺爺 can also be part of possessive structures like ‘我嘅爺爺’ to indicate ‘my grandfather.’
The word is typically used in informal and formal settings to refer to paternal grandfather, different from 外公 which means maternal grandfather.
